## Checklist

- [ ] Every fact links to the provider's own page, to the exact section, and each page is linked only once in README.md.
- [ ] Values the provider does not publish are left out or written as "Not published".
- [ ] `Verified` is set to the date I checked the sources.
- [ ] The At a Glance row is added or updated, and both are in alphabetical order.
- [ ] Tables are aligned (`python3 .github/scripts/review.py format README.md`) and `python3 .github/scripts/review.py check README.md` passes.
- [ ] If the provider publishes token caps or one-time token grants, I updated the totals in Combining Free Tiers, or noted that a maintainer should.
